population: The 256 keygen-labeled XMs of data/keygen-duration-reference.json, rendered by the pinned FT2 analysis build.
split: Calibration: first hex digit of Git blob SHA in 0-7. Held-out: 8-f. Only references with complete v6 profiles and pitch contexts enter either half.
anchor_rule: Content-like measurements get full credit from the calibration median; defect-like measurements from the calibration upper quartile. Bounds are rounded. Zero points are policy.
rejected_rule: Calibration 5th/95th percentile tails. Before any submission rescore they gave full sustained-noise credit to int16 bytes reinterpreted as int8 and to a melody under equal-power white noise.
unchanged: loop click, gap and rhythm bounds
unchanged_reason: The task requires a clean loop; 24% of references end in over a second of silence before restarting, and historical prevalence does not make an audible restart gap correct for this prompt. Development and dynamics distributions already overlap submissions.

restart_level_change_db.anchor: calibration upper quartile of gapless restarts

restart_spectral_distance.anchor: calibration upper quartile of gapless restarts

limitations: A convenience archive of one genre, not a census; filename-labeled XM only.
Bounds mark where credit stops increasing. They are not listener ratings and do not validate the tonal or noise proxies as measures of musical quality.
A median anchor gives half of the calibration references less than full credit on that measure by construction.
Held-out validation shows the bounds are not an artifact of one half of this archive; it does not show that they transfer to other scenes or eras.
